verdict.rationale: Terraform ships an official MCP server that gives AI models real-time access to provider docs, modules and policies, and HashiCorp says it enables more accurate Terraform configuration generation. That is first-party AI support for code generation. However, the natural-language-to-code generation itself happens in an external AI client; the evidence shows no assistant built into the Terraform CLI or toolchain. Missing for 10: a native natural-language-to-HCL generation feature in the CLI or HCP Terraform, documented end-to-end generation workflows, and independent or hands-on corroboration of generation quality.
